raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose
`test_stop_reason` samples (temperature 1, seed 42) for up to 1024 tokens with distilgpt2 and requires every prompt to stop at ".". The sampled tokens depend on batch composition (bf16), and the batch changes with timing because stop-string matches abort requests mid-batch, so some runs take a trajectory that never emits "." and finishes with "length". This flakes on `:amd: (MI355 DPX) Async Engine, Inputs, Utils, Worker` since #57599 moved the step to mi355_dpx on 2026-09-25 (about 3.6% of attempts, almost all in the stop-string block). It is not a seeded-sampling bug: batch size 1 or `VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1` make it reproducible.

Keep the strict per-prompt checks and add `logit_bias={stop_token_id: 5.0}` to the stop-token and stop-string requests, so every trajectory emits "." early.

## Test Plan
MI300X, CI image for main@38955340b7, original test vs. biased test.

## Test Result
- Original: fails on 2/12 seeds (outputs run to 1002 and 1005 tokens without ".").
- Biased: 24/24 passed over 12 seeds on two GPUs, plus 30/30 fresh runs with seed 42; longest output 160 tokens.

The description's cause doesn't match CI. This started on 2026-09-25, when #57599 moved the step from mi355_1 to mi355_dpx: 116/3259 MI355 DPX attempts fail since then (flat ~3.6%/week), vs 0/564 on full MI355 before the move, 0/126 on MI300 and 0/3384 on H200. 115 of the 116 fail in the stop-string block. Seeded sampling itself is fine; the tokens change with batch composition (bf16), and the batch changes with timing because stop-string matches abort requests mid-batch. Batch size 1 or `VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1` make it reproducible. Could you update the description so this isn't read as a ROCm seed bug or an Oct 21 regression?

Locally I see the same thing you describe: the test runs in bf16, the batch composition shifts with timing, and that changes the sampled path. In one run the first step scheduled 121 prefill tokens instead of 139. In another, 4 vs 3 sequences were running at step 104 because of a stop-string abort. With VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1 the outputs are identical across runs. "Since Oct 21" was only the window I scanned. I've rewritten the description to give the batch-composition cause and the Sep 25 start with #57599.
